page.content:
Kore who became queen of the Underworld.

How Persephone connects

  • Character: Demeter — Demeter's search for Persephone explains the barren season.
  • Character: Hades — Persephone reigns beside Hades as queen of the dead.

What is Persephone?

Persephone, daughter of Demeter, was taken by Hades and eats the pomegranate that binds her to spend part of each year below — the myth behind the seasons.

Key threads lead to Demeter and Hades.
